name: Iron Belt Interpretation Centre, Berango
story: The Iron Belt's western end ran through the Uribe district north of Bilbao to the coast at Barrika and Sopela. Remains of bunkers, trenches and gun emplacements survive in Barrika, Berango, Sopela, Urduliz, Gatika, Loiu, Mungia and Zamudio, marked by information panels. The small interpretation centre in Berango has graphic panels and a display of objects and documents on how the line was built and why it failed in June 1937. It makes a good starting point for walks to the coastal and inland remains.
see: An exhibition of panels, objects and documents, plus signposted remains of the line in the surrounding municipalities.
plan: The Museo Memorial del Cinturón de Hierro is at Simon Otxandategi Etorbidea 64, Berango (tel. 94 668 21 43). Walks to the coastal bunkers around Sopela and Berango take 1–2 h.
